Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A user-bookmarked and tagged log record saved for quick reference.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this bookmark.

sourceFile.description: Filename of the JSON or JSONL log file where the entry originated.

recordKey.description: Deterministic record identifier linking the bookmark to a parsed log entry.

recordIndex.description: 1-based record index within the source log collection.

title.description: Primary title of the bookmarked log entry.

subtitle.description: Secondary descriptor of the log entry.

recordUserId.description: Actor or userId extracted from the log entry.

actionName.description: Action or event name extracted from the log entry.

timestampText.description: Original timestamp string extracted from the log entry.

fieldsPreview.description: Formatted summary preview of key-value fields from the log entry.

note.description: Optional user reference note attached to the bookmark.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: User-owned log bookmarks with custom tags and reference notes.
